payload.rationale: The farmington/final_permit.pdf cover excerpt grounds that effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in Part I–IV for at least one permit package, which is consistent with—but does not by itself establish—the operative-Parts vs rationale-documents distinction for the full obligation. The fact-sheet and statement-of-basis headers identify draft supporting documents, but the packet supplies no language establishing that those documents function only as rationale and not as independent effluent limits, and it includes no Part-body excerpts showing enforceable numeric limits or monitoring requirements. Only NM0020583 is named in the packet; there is no per-facility operative-source grounding for NM0028762 or NM0000116, and no packet location ties the cited permit text to FY2025 enforceability. Neither the burden to ACCEPT the proposition across all listed facilities nor the burden to REJECT it is met; uncertainty is left unsupported rather than closed.
